$comment: Suite fixture (games contract r3): level 1 easy (hint color, 2500 ms up), level 2 hard (hint none, 800 ms up, two critters at once). Used by AC-205, AC-207, AC-228, AC-235, AC-241.
title: Loop bugs (suite)

levels.title: Sum to four

lesson.text: range(a, b) stops just before b, so range(1, 4) gives 1, 2 and 3.

levels.program:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 4):
    total += i
print(total)

bugs.why: range(1, 4) stops before 4, so 4 is never added.

levels.title: Backwards word

lesson.text: s[1:] drops the first character of s.

levels.program:
word = "code"
out = ""
for ch in word:
    out = ch + out
print(out[1:])

bugs.why: out[1:] drops the first letter of the reversed word.
